rows: Scrollytelling fit
Geographic or temporal story where scroll maps to narrative
Production cost is high; use for flagship pieces, not routine coverage.
Exploratory data story
Interactive visualization when users have multiple questions
Interaction must serve inquiry, not decorate the page.
Explanatory data story
Narrative visualization for one specific data message
Authorial sequencing is a feature, not a limitation.
Branching story
Finite meaningful decisions with multiple paths
Full branching explodes; funneling and delayed consequences are normal.
VR/immersive story
Physical presence at scene is central
Presence is not the same as empathy or durable behavior change.
Podcast narrative
Audio-primary story with serial commitment
On-demand structure differs from broadcast scheduling.
Longform web
Committed reader and 2,000-20,000 word depth
Length requires structure, navigation, and payoff.
